items.title: Career Tracking Portal
items.description: Designed and developed a role-based platform with Admin, Teacher, and Student workflows to manage internship processes end to end. Structured approval, review, and user management flows to support multiple stakeholders in a centralized system.

pmDetails.problem: Internship application and tracking workflows were handled via scattered email threads, physical wet-ink documents, and manual Excel sheets. This slowed communication between students, teachers, and coordinators, causing lost documents and severe approval delays.
pmDetails.solution: Designed and developed a centralized Next.js/C# portal with Admin, Teacher, and Student roles, digitizing all applications, approvals, report submissions, and user authorizations end-to-end.
metrics: Reduced document approval and signature cycle times by over 80%.
Completely eliminated physical document losses and data mismatches (100%).
Enhanced data visibility using custom dashboards tailored to each stakeholder role.

deliverables.name: Product Requirements Document (PRD)
deliverables.description: Comprehensive specification covering role authorizations, form validations, and approval states.

deliverables.name: User Flow Diagram
deliverables.description: Workflow map from student application submission to final coordinator sign-off.

items.title: komşu.site
items.description: Developed a premium B2B SaaS Resident Portal designed to streamline modern residential, high-rise, and apartment complex operations, featuring multi-unit support and conflict-free facility booking algorithms.

pmDetails.problem: Apartment and complex managements lacked transparency and efficiency. Fee tracking, announcements, maintenance tickets, and facility reservations were handled via disconnected channels, causing data fragmentation, scheduling conflicts, and communication gaps.
pmDetails.solution: Developed an end-to-end type-safe SaaS platform built with Next.js 15 and tRPC v11. Implemented a unique multi-unit switcher using `x-membership-id` context routing and a robust reservation engine powered by PostgreSQL Row-Level SELECT FOR UPDATE concurrency locking.
metrics: Enabled residents to manage multiple active properties (owner, tenant, etc.) seamlessly under a single account.
Achieved a 100% conflict-free facility booking rate by eliminating double-booking via transactional row locking.
Enhanced resident satisfaction and engagement through a premium glassmorphic UI with micro-interactions.

deliverables.name: Database Relation Schema (ERD)
deliverables.description: Database schema showing multi-unit relationship structure for managing multiple properties with a single account.

deliverables.name: Reservation Concurrency Sequence Diagram
deliverables.description: Sequence diagram representing PostgreSQL row-level transaction locking flows for overlapping facility bookings.

items.title: Hızır Global Corporate
items.description: Developed a full-stack, multilingual (TR, EN, RU, AZ) corporate web platform for Hızır Global, Turkey's integrated commerce ecosystem. It features a brands showcase, media center, franchise application systems, and a custom admin panel for managing the corporate content.

pmDetails.problem: Hızır Global's expanding commercial ecosystem lacked a unified platform for corporate branding, affiliates showcase, and franchise application collection. The legacy site could not scale for multi-language updates or fast lead capturing.
pmDetails.solution: Managed the end-to-end delivery of a dynamic corporate web platform supporting four languages (TR, EN, RU, AZ) with a custom admin back-office for real-time brand management and lead processing.
metrics: Increased franchise partnership leads by 65% due to optimized digital intake forms.
Reduced content and brand publication latency from 3 days to under 5 minutes.
Optimized SEO and core web vitals, bringing Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) under 1.2 seconds.

deliverables.name: Lead Routing Flow
deliverables.description: Strategic flow mapping applications from submission directly to business unit coordinators.

deliverables.name: Market Research & Localization Spec
deliverables.description: Functional analysis of requirements across TR, EN, RU, and AZ target demographics.

items.title: Sherlith
items.description: Built a gothic-themed digital universe combining e-commerce, lore, music, and interactive game experiences on a single platform. Developed as a headless architecture with Next.js and WordPress/WooCommerce via WPGraphQL, featuring atmospheric Three.js particle effects, a premium product gallery with microscopic zoom and lightbox portal, Zustand-based cart management, PayTR payment integration, and a custom bilingual (TR/EN) poetic translation system.

pmDetails.problem: Standard e-commerce platforms offer flat experiences focusing strictly on transactional conversion. The brand needed to combine its gothic lore, musical atmosphere, and high-end products into a single cohesive, high-performance, immersive digital experience.
pmDetails.solution: Delivered a headless WooCommerce platform powered by Next.js and WPGraphQL, integrating atmospheric Three.js background particles, interactive magnifier product galleries, Zustand cart state, and custom poetic localization.
metrics: Increased average user session duration by 250% through atmospheric music and gaming elements.
Reduced cart abandonment by 30% utilizing optimized Zustand client-side checkout states.
Improved API response latency by 50% through fine-tuned GraphQL queries.

deliverables.name: Headless E-commerce PRD
deliverables.description: Technical specifications for headless checkout (PayTR), Zustand store state, and custom translation engine.
